No Substances card: the compound is table-only, not tagged.
items.needed: Keep the qualitative presence row. Do not restore the unsupported 3.2 g figure. Do not convert extracted-fraction yields into a USDA-style number. Do not create a pectin substance page from Overview mention alone.

items.not: Overview → table gap. Presence of inulin-type fructans in edible spear is already evidenced by the public qualitative row.
items.presence: Resolved for inulin-type fructans in edible spear. Public table row: Present — quantity not established, with Goñi et al. 2024 and Redondo-Cuenca et al. 2023 as food-specific sources. Inulin was about 1.3–1.5 g/100 g dry weight in edible spear versus about 15–16 g/100 g dry weight in root. DP3/DP4 oligosaccharides were quantified in root only.
remaining_gaps: No defensible fresh-weight USDA-comparable FOS or inulin quantity for SR Legacy Asparagus, raw (FDC 168389). That panel reports total fibre 2.1 g/100 g only.
Short-chain FOS (DP3/DP4) are not established in the edible spear represented by the USDA table.
No canonical inulin or FOS substance page, and no Substances card is admitted from this row.
items.needed: Do not convert dry-weight spear inulin into a USDA-style fresh-weight FOS number. Do not treat root-extract or by-product fructan papers as spear composition. Do not create a FOS substance page from Overview mention alone.
